A.title: Stair That Hums
A.text: Every step rings a small note. Walk heavy and the notes pile up, and then the cave answers. Walk soft, on the edge of the step, and the cave lets you pass.

Y.title: Tuning Fork Rule
Y.text: Do not strike the forks. Crystal here wants to ring, and the more it rings the louder the wisps get. Leave them be; carry no metal in your hand if you can help it.

R.title: The Cracked Lens
R.text: Hold a shard to the lamp and the light splits in seven. One strand is yours; follow it back and you find where you started, and who. The old delvers called it the road home.

G.title: Names on the Wall
G.text: Someone scratched a name a hundred times; another has scratched the same name beneath. The first is the woman who walked in. The second is her daughter, who came to look; neither has a third.

M.title: Quiet Chamber Law
M.text: The vault is dead silent; if you speak low, the cave repeats it back a moment late. Say a name aloud and you will hear it answered. I advise you not to say a name.

O.title: The Choir Barracks
O.text: The barracks hold stone figures in rows, mouths open; when one cracks, the sound wakes the others. Break them one by one, not in a pile. Sound carries here.

U.title: Wisp Hatchery Note
U.text: Wisps are born in the geode and drift out. They are drawn to noise; be quiet and they pass you by. A loud man gets a ring of them; they do not bite; they only follow.

X.title: Queen's Resonance
X.text: At the bottom the queen sings one note, low, under your feet. It is not a song; it is more like a tooth being pulled; plug your ears if you have wax. I had none.
